heading: What `linear_scan: false` is not
text:
### What `linear_scan: false` is not [LNLS.1.3]

- Not a synonym for `realtime`.  The two are orthogonal and can be used
  independently or together.  `linear_scan: false` is about algorithmic
  shape; `realtime` is about the allocation and lifecycle model.
- Not a performance dial.  It is a semantic constraint.  A program
  that compiles under `linear_scan: false` has certain complexity guarantees
  regardless of engine version or hardware.
- Not a subset of valid DS programs.  It is a different set of
  programs.  A `linear_scan: false` program may use any feature not listed in
  [LNLS.3]; those features are not "disabled", they are fully active.
